text: {"lessons":["A gain on one position does not mean its price will keep rising; past price changes do not predict future returns.","Selling winners felt satisfying, but I should decide whether to sell based on the investment outlook and portfolio needs, not just the gain or fear of giving it back.","I should judge my decisions over time and across the whole portfolio, rather than treating a profitable sale or a short-term account move as proof that my approach works."]}
